parts.name: SS13 low sandstone court wall
parts.description: A 4 m sandstone court wall, 1.25 m tall. Add SS15 coping for a 1.5 m top.

parts.name: SS13 short sandstone court wall
parts.description: A 2 m sandstone court wall, 1.25 m tall. Add SS15 coping for a 1.5 m top.

parts.name: SS15 alternating sandstone coping
parts.description: A 4 m coping with alternating taller and flatter caps. Adds 0.25 m above a wall.

parts.name: SS15 short alternating sandstone coping
parts.description: A 2 m coping with alternating taller and flatter caps. Adds 0.25 m above a wall.

parts.name: SS15 sandstone coping turn
parts.description: A plain 90-degree coping return. Finished end faces join straight runs; 0.5 m-wide arms.

parts.name: SS16 sandstone court gatepost
parts.description: A broad 1.5 m sandstone gatepost with a plain chamfered cap. Gate leaf separate.

parts.name: SS17 sandstone slab bench
parts.description: A broad stone seat on two low feet. Open space remains between the supports.

parts.name: SS18 carved sandstone trough
parts.description: A hollow stone trough with a 1.75 by 0.5 m basin, 0.25 m deep. No water simulation.

parts.name: SS19 sandstone threshold steps
parts.description: Solid sandstone steps: 1.5 m wide, 0.5 m rise over 1 m run. Continue from either end.

parts.name: SS20 sandstone half-storey stair
parts.description: Solid sandstone steps: 1.5 m wide, 1.5 m rise over 2 m run. Continue from either end.

parts.name: SS21 battered sandstone terrace wall
parts.description: A 4 m terrace wall with a battered face, 0.75 m base and 0.5 m top. Does not alter terrain.

parts.name: SS22 open sandstone drain
parts.description: A 2 m open channel with a 0.25 m clear width and 0.125 m depth. Both ends stay open; no fluid simulation.

parts.name: SS23 sandstone corbel shelf
parts.description: A built-in stone shelf projecting 0.5 m. Two corbel tails seat 0.25 m into compatible solid masonry.

parts.name: SS24 sandstone hearth curb
parts.description: A square stone curb around a clear 1 m centre. No floor slab, fire, cooking or chimney included.
